name: HaxeFlixel/flixel
description: Free, cross-platform 2D game engine powered by Haxe and OpenFL, enabling native and web deployment from a single codebase. Inspired by ActionScript Flixel.
score_rationale: 2.2k stars, MIT, the primary 2D game engine for Haxe with strong cross-platform capabilities and active use in indie games.
summary: Cross-platform 2D engine for Haxe with native and web deployment
